datum: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia.
God is love: + and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, * and God in him.

versus: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity: quicken Thou me in Thy way.

datum: V. I said, Lord, be merciful unto me.
R. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against Thee.
Lead me * in the path of Thy commandments, O Lord.
Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: + save me, and I shall be saved: * for Thou art my praise.

responsum: For I have sinned against Thee.
versus: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me.

datum: V. Be Thou mine Helper, neither leave me,
R. Nor forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, + that I will raise unto David a righteous branch: and a King shall reign in wisdom, * and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

versus: Cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

datum: V. The heathen shall fear Thy Name, O Lord.
R. And all the kings of the earth Thy glory.
Behold now hath arrived * the day of repentance, to redeem sins, and save souls.
Turn ye to Me with all your heart, with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning. + And rend your heart and not your garments, * saith the Lord almighty.

responsum: From the snare of the fowler.

datum: V. He shall cover thee with His wings.
R. And under His feathers shalt thou trust.
Lord, Thou hast judged * the cause of my soul. Thou hast redeemed my life, O Lord my God.
Lord, all that forsake Thee shall be ashamed: + they that depart from Thee shall be written in the earth: * because they have forsaken the Lord, the fountain of living waters.

versus: And my darling from the power of the dog.

datum: V. O Lord, save me from the lion's mouth.
R. And mine affliction from the horns of the unicorns.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
Christ, being raised from the dead, dieth no more, death hath no more dominion over Him. + For in that He died, He died unto sin once; * but in that He liveth, He liveth unto God.

incipit: The Lord is risen from the grave
versus: Who hung for us upon the tree.

datum: V. The Lord is risen indeed, Alleluia.
R. And hath appeared to Simon, Alleluia.
Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Kyrie eleison.
V. Turn us again, O Lord God of hosts.
R. And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
R. And deliver us for Thy Name's sake.
